purpose: Read-only profile attribution and bounded software-v2 rationale; persistent raw-slot design is not implemented.

polling.interpretation: Repeated repair-status MMIO is measurable CPU overhead. RAW-loop service runs during fixed hardware LOAD work, so its removed cycles are not independent frame savings. DL-boundary polling is ordinary CPU work; the paired replay must decide wall-clock gain.
polling.v2_change: Service once at gfx_run_dl entry, then existing acquire/wait/fence/frame-end points; rawLOAD polls service every16 busy iterations using existing remaining countdown. Timeout drain/startup busy loops and all SDK wait hooks unchanged. Repair body, queue admission, commands, ownership, and RTL unchanged.
polling.liveness: Worker relinquishes shared FMA before CPU repair wait. Raw LOAD can progress even if repair is deferred. Full-ring/fence wait hooks still service repair, as do CLAIM, DL entry, raw polls, and frame end. Reviewer independently agreed.

persistent_slot_rtl_proof.claim: XYZW writes use row and dest+local returned vertex. Existing acc output RAM preserves all other slots.
Inverse writes use context[32+recip_tag]; recip_tag is dest+local. Matrix writes use context[0..15], disjoint from all32 inverses.
DMA, lighting, and queued-cull scratch reuse positions RAM, distinct from final acc, inverses and attributes.
UV, source/final RGB/A, and clip rows write only dest+local. Successful partial LOAD does not clear survivor output words.

The existing valid_slots mechanism invalidates incoming slots at START, commits them only on successful scan, and can invalidate software-overwritten slots. Wrapper currently disables/discards this mechanism.

persistent_slot_required_changes: Expose LOAD dest0..31 and raw valid_slots; invalidate software-fallback destination slots even when no hardware LOAD starts.
Preserve importable and W-hash metadata outside overwritten mask. They currently clear globally at every START; valid_slots must gate all metadata.
Change CPU alias from latest-job count bounds to an immutable valid-slot mask captured at AR; after a failed partial LOAD untouched survivors remain readable although latest-job success is false.

Change snapshot source validation from src<lastLOADcount to a captured valid-slot mask. The current copier already copies all256 words, so persistent32slot contents need no extra snapshot data BRAM. Use global indices with first0 for mixed-generation runs.

Use a raw-state epoch or explicitly serialize release/reclaim at every mutation, including failed START and software invalidation. Current generation advances only on success; failed partial overwrite must never let an old owned token describe the changed raw bank.
Accumulate logical pending/raw-owned masks instead of resetting them to latest LOAD. Global slot mapping removes raw_first subtraction. Do not permit slots>=32 into this path.
Replace ctz-to-clz bulk canonical copy with exact pending runs once per CPU fallback entry: persistent masks can be sparse, and copying gaps would overwrite newer software/fog canonical values.
Invalidate aligned alias cachelines covering dest..dest+count after writes, including any needed failure path. Existing discard starts at slot0 and is unsuitable for globaldest.
Preserve fog flush before coefficient changes and copy-before-alpha. Persistent BRAM cannot remove canonical fog work required by existing single pending fog-context semantics.
Hold existing short raw-copy reservation before the next mutation; snapshot ownership remains independent of later LOAD, and old queued jobs read immutable banks.
persistent_slot_limit: Completed Q warm run copies only71 survivor vertices out of3388 total canonical materializations (~2.10%). Persistent slots may improve mixed-generation queue admission, but current counters do not isolate that reject reason. Removing survivor copies alone is not supported as a substantial speedup; no new implementation or FPS prediction.
scope: Two prepared native intervals; retirement-gap attribution includes memory stalls and overlaps hardware activity. Q queued-v1 aborted old-driver run excluded; completed queued-v2 used.
